steps.prompt: Our RD has the puck behind our net, and their C is chasing. Where will the puck go?

options.text: Up the right wall to our RW
options.fb: Right. Our RW waits at the hash marks on that wall. A rim along the boards goes away from their C and reaches our RW before the forecheck does.

options.text: Across to our LD on the far side
options.fb: Possible, and it moves the puck away from their C. But it stays behind our net, and their forwards get one more chance to chase it.

options.text: Out in front to our C
options.fb: That pass goes into the slot, right past their C. If they take it there, they shoot at our net from close in.

options.text: Up the far wall to our LW
options.fb: Our LW is open, but the pass crosses the whole zone, through their RW in the middle. A long pass across our zone is the one they want.

steps.prompt: Our RD is about to send it, with their C close. Who is the outlet on this side?

options.text: Our RW, stopped at the hash marks
options.fb: Right. Our RW is stopped on the wall, with their back to the boards. The rim reaches them before their C can turn, and they look up the ice.

options.text: Our C, low in the middle
options.fb: Our C is the next outlet if the wall is covered. Here the wall is open, and a pass to the middle has to beat their C first.

options.text: Our LW, on the far wall
options.fb: Our LW is the outlet on the far side. From the right of our net, that pass crosses the whole zone, past their C and their RW.

steps.prompt: Our RD is about to rim it. Tap where our RW waits for it.

fb.right: Right. The hash marks on the right wall, stopped, back to the boards. The rim comes along the boards to them.
fb.close: Near, but not on the hash marks. A step off the wall, and the rim goes past our RW behind them.
fb.wrong: Our RW waits on their own wall, at the hash marks. Anywhere else, the rim has nobody to reach.
